name: Doornik-628A
description: Doornik-628A was the first planet in the Doornik-628 system, located in the Farlax sector. It was a part of the Koornacht Cluster, itself a region of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. One of the three gas giants in the system, which was centered around the star Doornik-628, Doornik-628A was orbited by three moons.
